gloss: to poke; to peck at; to pick at (food); to nitpick

definitions.gloss: to poke; to prod; to jab
definitions.explanation: To repeatedly push at something with a finger, stick, or pointed object.

definitions.gloss: to peck at; to pick at (food)
definitions.explanation: To eat in small amounts, poking at food without much appetite. Also used for birds pecking.

definitions.gloss: to nitpick; to find fault with
definitions.explanation: To criticize minor flaws or point out small problems.

examples.japanese: {棒|ぼう}で{虫|むし}を{突|つ}っついた。
examples.english: I poked the bug with a stick.

examples.japanese: {隣|となり}の{人|ひと}を{肘|ひじ}で{突|つ}っついて{合図|あいず}した。
examples.english: I nudged the person next to me with my elbow to signal them.

examples.japanese: {鳥|とり}が{餌|えさ}を{突|つ}っつく。
{食欲|しょくよく}がなくて、{料理|りょうり}を{突|つ}っつくだけだった。
examples.english: I had no appetite and just picked at my food.

examples.japanese: {鍋|なべ}を{突|つ}っつきながら{話|はなし}をした。
examples.english: We chatted while picking at a hot pot.

examples.japanese: {細|こま}かいことを{突|つ}っつく。
{上司|じょうし}にミスを{突|つ}っつかれた。
examples.english: My boss picked on my mistakes.

examples.japanese: {弱点|じゃくてん}を{突|つ}っつかれると{困|こま}る。
examples.english: It's troublesome when someone pokes at your weak points.

notes:
A colloquial godan verb that is an emphatic or repeated-action form of {突|つ}く (to poke). The っ gemination adds a sense of repeated, light action.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {指|ゆび}で{突|つ}っつく: to poke with a finger
- {鍋|なべ}を{突|つ}っつく: to share a hot pot (picking at it together)
- {細|こま}かいことを{突|つ}っつく: to nitpick
- {痛|いた}いところを{突|つ}っつく: to touch on a sore spot

USAGE:
The hot-pot usage ({鍋|なべ}を{突|つ}っつく) is a common casual expression for sharing a communal dish, conveying a friendly, informal atmosphere.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {突|つ}く: to poke, to thrust — the base verb; more general and can indicate a single, stronger action
- つつく: to peck, to poke — a softer variant without the geminate っ; essentially the same word
- {指摘|してき}する: to point out — formal equivalent of the nitpicking sense

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {突|つ}っついていませんでした
